notes: PartCraft is quicker to sketch and change: type sizes as you draw (each becomes a dimension), drag handles on an Extrude or Revolve, Extrude from it, Cut into it or Hole here from a picked face, values right in the history (double-click or F2 to change them), base planes that step back once a part has a solid, and repeated relations in one row. Export › Nest flat parts on sheets… nests plates or a roll with grain, turns and spacing, small parts in big parts' holes, and saves DXF for the laser or waterjet. Tolerance stack-ups in assemblies give worst case, RSS, parts per million outside your limits and which dimensions matter most, from ISO 2768, the drawing's GD&T or typed values. The CraftScript library gains frame3d. A second round adds configurations that turn features off and permanent magnets in 2-D magnetics. An assembly with a stack-up (assembly file version 5) or a part whose configuration turns features off (part file version 4) won't open in PartCraft 0.5. Fixed: a single typed digit plus Enter did nothing. Every app gets Show bars, Reset the layout, a toolbar menu, an interface size and pen and touch. Spanish (es-MX) and, new, Bahasa Indonesia are machine-made drafts, not yet reviewed.
